text.description_html:
Yale YBNDR-72, 72 Inch Barn Door Flat Track Hardware Kit

The 72 Inch Soft Open Complete Barn Door System contains everything you'll need to install a sliding barn door. The 72 Inch Barn Door Flat Track Hardware Kit can accommodate openings up to 3 feet wide and doors up to 200 pounds! The 1/4 inch steel track paired with the nylon pulley and ball bearing operation insures that your Sliding Barn Door Kit will last for years to come. This modern barn door track set is available in a few contemporary finishes. Along with the anti-jump design that will keep the sliding door from easily falling off the track, the Yale Expressions YBNDR kit includes a soft open and close system.

Also Available: 96 Inch Barn Door Flat Track Hardware Kit

Specifications of the 72 Inch Flat Track Steel Barn Door Kit:

  • Track: 72" (6 feet)
  • For door opening up to 36" (3 feet)
  • For wood doors up to 200 LBS.
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/8" to 1-3/4"
  • 1/4" Steel Track
  • Nylon pulley with ball bearings for silent, smooth, and long lasting operation.
  • Yale YBNDR-72 Specifications Diagram (PDF)

Comes with all necessary hardware to install barn door.

  • (1) Steel 72" Track
  • (2) Soft Open/Close System
  • (2) Hangers
  • (2) Anti-Jump Discs
  • (2) Doorstops
  • (1) Single Floor Mounted Door Guide
  • (1) Double Floor Mounted Door Guide
  • All necessary installation hardware.
